What Is Shopify?

Shopify is a robust platform that helps people create and manage online stores. It allows you to create a professional-looking Shopify website even if you don’t have any technical expertise. Whether you’re selling clothes, gadgets, or digital products, Shopify makes it easy.

You can use built-in Shopify apps, select from a variety of Shopify templates, and use Shopify Payments to take payments. Many small and medium-sized businesses use it to expand their eCommerce store gradually.

Additionally, you can contact Shopify customer service or support at any time if you need assistance.

What Is Shopify Plus?

The upgraded version of Shopify is known as Shopify Plus. It is designed for large brands or fast-growing businesses that require additional functionality, flexibility, and strength.

Most businesses find that standard Shopify works fine for them. Still, Shopify Plus provides many more features, including enhanced flexibility, faster speed, better automation, and first-rate support. It’s ideal for businesses that require enterprise-level tools and want to scale without limits.

With Shopify Plus stores, you can create incredible user experiences. With Shopify Plus, you get premium support, which consists of a dedicated team that is always available to assist.

Why This Blog Post Is Important

Suppose you are managing a growing business and considering whether to switch to Shopify Plus or stick with Shopify. In that case, this blog post is for you.

We’ll use straightforward language to explain the differences between Shopify and Shopify Plus. So you can understand and make an informed decision on which one to choose. This article will help you in selecting the best solution for your company, whether you’re comparing Shopify plans or researching the costs of Shopify Plus.

Key Differences Between Shopify and Shopify Plus

Shopify Pricing vs Shopify Plus Pricing

Let’s start with cost.

  • Shopify Pricing: Shopify offers many plans—Basic, Shopify, and Advanced. The monthly cost starts at about $39 and increases according to the features. But as your business grows, you may require more advanced features and tools.
  • Shopify Plus Pricing: Shopify Plus doesn’t have a fixed cost. The Shopify Plus cost usually starts at $2,000/month, depending on your store’s income and requirements. While it’s more costly, it provides you access to premium features that aren’t available in standard plans.

So, if you’re earning higher revenue and require more support, Shopify Plus is worth the investment.

Support System Comparison

In terms of support, Shopify offers phone, chat, and email support around the clock. However, this is simple Shopify customer service.

With Shopify Plus support, you get an individual support executive. They help with the smooth setup, migration, and growth of your store. You get priority help and faster solutions.

Customization Options and Templates

You can use a variety of Shopify theme templates for your store. You can also customize them with simple tools or code.

However, Shopify Plus provides even more customization options. You can cooperate with a Shopify Plus agency, Shopify Plus developers, or Shopify Plus designers to redesign your Shopify store fully. It allows you to take complete control over how your Shopify Plus stores look and feel.

Checkout Customization

The checkout page is not very customizable for normal Shopify users. You can fully personalize the checkout with Shopify Plus using Shopify Scripts. You can offer discounts, upsells, and personalized experiences that regular users cannot.

Shopify Apps and API Access

Shopify apps are helpful and can be used on both platforms. Shopify Plus, however, provides you with a more powerful API. It allows developers to create custom features and integrate third-party tools. A Shopify Plus development company can help in creating cutting-edge solutions that perfectly meet your business’s requirements.

Benefits of Shopify Plus for High-Growth Businesses

Scalability and Growth Support

Shopify Plus is designed for large companies and rapidly growing brands. It provides better performance and handles more traffic with ease.

With the help of a Shopify Plus ecommerce agency or Shopify Plus experts, you can scale your business smoothly. You don’t have to be concerned about your store going down during holidays or major deals.

Access to Shopify Plus Partners and Experts

For improved results, you can work with a Shopify Plus agency. These Shopify experts have an in-depth understanding of the platform and can guide you through complex tasks.

Whether it’s design, development, or SEO, a Shopify Plus partner or Shopify Plus development agency makes everything easier.

Advanced Integrations and Automation

Shopify Plus contains tools like:

  • Shopify Flow: Automate tasks (like sending emails or tagging customers).
  • Launchpad: Schedule sales, product releases, and discounts.
  • Scripts: Customize checkout logic.

These tools are perfect for large stores, saving a lot of time.

B2B Selling and Wholesale Support

Shopify Plus provides unique features for business-to-business sales. You can create wholesale channels, price lists, and custom payment terms.

Your B2B clients will have the same smooth shopping experience as your B2C clients with Shopify Plus websites.

When Should You Upgrade to Shopify Plus?

Is Your Business Ready for Shopify Plus?

Here are some signs:

  • Your monthly revenue is $50,000 or more.
  • Your team needs better tools and automation.
  • Your store requires handling large spikes in traffic.
  • You want more customization and control.

If this sounds like your business, Shopify Plus is a smart move.

Shopify Plus Cost: Is It Worth It?

The Shopify Plus pricing starts at $2,000/month. You’re paying for speed, security, customization, and support, even though it can appear expensive. For big brands, it’s worth the price.

When you compare this with increasing Shopify costs, you can see why large companies choose Shopify Plus.

How the Shopify to Shopify Plus Migration Works

Upgrading is easy.

  • Contact a Shopify Plus agency.
  • Collaborate with a Shopify Plus partner to plan your store setup.
  • Transfer your data and apps.
  • Customize your checkout page and theme templates.
  • Launch with help from your Shopify Plus support team.

FAQs

What is the difference between Shopify and Shopify Plus?

Shopify is built for small to mid-sized businesses, while Shopify Plus is for large or fast-growing brands with heavy traffic and lots of orders.

Shopify Plus offers advanced features, better customization, automation, and support.

How much does Shopify Plus cost?

The starting price for Shopify Plus is about $2,000/month. Depending on the size and needs of your store, the cost could go up.

Do I need a Shopify Plus agency to use it?

It’s not required to use a Shopify Plus store, but a Shopify Plus agency can help you create, set up, customize, and scale your Shopify Plus store more effectively.

Can I switch from Shopify to Shopify Plus easily?

Yes, you can migrate your standard Shopify store to a Shopify Plus store, and upgrading is smooth. You can take help from Shopify Plus support, or you can hire a Shopify expert or a Shopify Plus agency to help you migrate your store.

Does Shopify Plus offer better customer support?

Yes, of course. You will get a dedicated Launch Engineer and team with 24/7 priority support. Your issue will be given priority over all the standard stores.

What makes Shopify Plus better for big brands?

Shopify Plus provides high-level security, advanced features, faster performance, and better automation tools—ideal for enterprise requirements.
